title: Move place data in-house with Overture Places to end the public-Overpass dependency
description: Public Overpass mirrors throttle under load and return HTTP 200 with an empty element set, which reads as a food desert. Overture Places is CDLA-Permissive licensed with no share-alike, about 1GB for a US eat-and-drink subset, and removes the request-time external dependency entirely.

title: Stand up the web app and API behind Caddy at noupick.intentsolutions.io
description: Single Node service on port 8094 under systemd serving both the JSON API and the built Vite app, with Porkbun DNS, automatic TLS and the shared security-headers snippet.
close_reason: Live at https://noupick.intentsolutions.io — systemd unit noupick.service on :8094, Porkbun A record to 167.86.106.29, Caddy vhost validated before reload, HSTS + X-Frame-Options + X-Content-Type-Options confirmed on the response.

title: Delete the fabricated rating and open-closed fields from the restaurant card
description: Both were emitted by the model with no source of record. The card now shows computed distance and a closing time only when opening_hours data supports one.
close_reason: Card.tsx now renders computed distance and a closing time only when opening_hours yields an unambiguous single range. Verified: Domino's Mobile AL (spec 'Mo-Th 10:30-24:00; Fr-Sa 10:30-01:00; Su 10:30-24:00') correctly emits no hours claim instead of the wrong '12pm'.

title: Move randomness out of the prompt and into a seeded shuffle with a cursor
description: Variety was attempted by injecting a random integer into the prompt. Replaced with a seeded permutation plus a per-session cursor, guaranteeing no repeat until the pool is exhausted and removing the ever-growing excludeNames list.
close_reason: server/src/pick.ts implements a mulberry32-seeded Fisher-Yates plus category stratification; the cursor is carried by the client. Verified: 15 consecutive picks across 5 spins returned 15 unique places, 0 repeats.

title: Replace the LLM-as-search-engine with a real place-data provider
description: Gemini was asked to invent restaurants, ratings and open/closed status as free text, parsed by regex on both server and client. Facts now come from OpenStreetMap via Overpass with Nominatim geocoding; the model is out of the discovery path entirely.
close_reason: Facts now come from OpenStreetMap via Overpass (server/src/places.ts) with Nominatim geocoding (server/src/geo.ts). Verified live: Austin/Any returns a 338-place pool, Nashville/Sushi 27, Portland/Coffee 121. No model is involved in discovery.

title: Re-platform No, YOU Pick! off the retired Google Cloud stack onto the self-hosted VPS
description: The app ran entirely on GCP (Firebase Hosting, Cloud Run, Vertex AI Gemini). That estate was torn down 2026-07-09, so both the web app and the API returned 404 and the project sat dead for five months. Rebuilt on the Contabo VPS with real place data instead of model-invented data, live at noupick.intentsolutions.io.

title: Port the mobile app to the new API and reach parity with the web app
description: pablo-mobile is a 450-line form and list with no geolocation, mascot, slot machine or share ticket, still pointing at the dead Cloud Run URL. It also targets API 35, below the Google Play minimum of 36.
close_reason: Expo SDK 54->57 (RN 0.86.3), points at the live API, adds expo-location geolocation + native share + haptics + AsyncStorage favorites + SVG mascot. Verified: expo-doctor 21/21, tsc clean, 10/10 jest, expo export builds both platforms (712 iOS / 710 Android modules, 1.7MB Hermes each), live API contract check passes all 11 Restaurant fields. NOT submitted — eas.json needs ascAppId/appleTeamId (Pablo's interactive login) and no device testing has happened.

title: Add the LLM back as an offline batch copywriter for the restaurant one-liners
description: Reason text is currently templated from real fields. Generating richer lines in batch and caching them per place keeps the model out of the request path, so a provider outage cannot break the app.
